Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: Correct Magic Eden buyV2 to SALE instead of BID

CRITICAL BUG FIX: Magic Eden buyV2 instruction was incorrectly classified as BID.

The buyV2 instruction is when a buyer PURCHASES an NFT, which is a SALE event,
not a BID event. This was causing all Magic Eden sales to be saved as BIDs.

Changes:
- Changed event_type from ''BID'' to ''SALE'' in _parse_me_v2_bid function
- Added NFT transfer detection to get accurate buyer/seller/mint info
- Updated docstring to clarify this is a purchase \(SALE\), not an offer \(BID\)

Impact:
- Database had 5,378 LISTING events and 5 BID events
- Those 5 "BID" events were actually SALES
- After this fix, new sales will be correctly captured as SALE events
- This fixes the 0 SALE events issue despite Magic Eden showing real sales
